description: Configure the email authentication, return path, and optional tracking and receiving records shown in your Postfleet dashboard.
variableDescription:
DKIM_KEY: provider-issued public DKIM key without p= prefix. SEND_REGION and RECEIVE_REGION: AWS region names from
    provider MX targets. SEND_PRIORITY and RECEIVE_PRIORITY: provider MX priorities. Use the standard host parameter for subdomains. Select sending
    and optional tracking/receiving groups only when present in provider records.
